author: Learn Linux TV
description:
GNOME 51 is here! In this video, I walk through what’s new in the latest release of the GNOME desktop. We’ll cover what GNOME OS is, the biggest new features, improvements to GNOME Software and the file previewer, and the removal of support for legacy NVIDIA proprietary drivers. At the end, I’ll share my overall thoughts on whether GNOME 51 is worth the upgrade.
